title: Cut Susi Tools code no Susi development uses; add local-harvest notices
goal: Every line of Susi Tools traces to Susi's development (CEO, 2026-11-22). An audit of 2026-11-23 found commands, options and read paths nothing calls: cut them, with their tests and docs. Fix what the audit suspected in tasks list (a stale local main) and in the hooks (the index a partial commit uses). Add the local-harvest notices command that Susi's ledger, its release gate and the audit tell people to run, which fails on Linux today.

reuse.searched: Susi Tools' own harvest audit (src/harvest.rs: load_manifests and render_notices already build and compare THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES), the earlier local-harvest's notices command (Susi commit 5404fd12, tools/core-xtask/src/harvest.rs: notices writes the file, notices --check reports current, stale or missing), Susi's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and release gate (crates/susi-release/src/harvest_gate.rs); for each cut, its callers in Susi and Susi Core (.githooks, AGENTS.md, README, docs, scripts, tests) and the canonical server's bin folder
reuse.reason: the notices command reuses the audit's own renderer and the earlier program's contract, so nothing new is designed; the cuts and the two fixes change existing code only
